'''Morphing Manectric''' (Japanese: '''ライボルト、化わる''' ''{{tt|Livolt|Manectric}}, Change'') is the 567th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 19th chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|X}} continues his battle against the {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}.
* {{adv|Trevor}} helps X battle the Grunt.
* [[Clemont]] tells {{adv|Y}} more about {{kal|Grace|her mother}}'s kidnapping.
* [[Cassius]] arrives and defeats the Grunt's {{p|Espurr}}.
* Clemont is sent flying by Psychic energy after he opens the Grunt's Espurr's ears to see the organs under them.
* At the cost of her flower, Trevor's {{p|Flabébé}} retrieves [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] and Élec's Mega Stones and gives them back.
* X [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolves]] Élec into Mega Manectric, allowing it to defeat the Grunt.
* The Grunt escapes, but drops a document containing a list of various Pokémon and the Mega Stones required to Mega Evolve them.
* X and Trevor return to their friends, only to find Y depressed from the news about her mother.
* Cassius introduces himself and his friends to X's group.
* Cassius introduces [[Emma]], who has adopted one of the Grunt's Espurr.

{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
